annotations.title: Create a clip from a time range

description: Create a NEW clip from any time range of a completed job's source video, when the user wants a moment Katto did not pick. start_seconds/end_seconds are SOURCE-video seconds (take them from katto_get_transcript segments); the clip must last 3-180 s. Does NOT use video quota. Limits: at most 10 created clips per video, one clip in preparation at a time (409 'Another clip is being prepared' = wait and retry), and only within 7 days of the job (410 after that: the source is no longer kept). Captions come from the words Katto already timed; has_captions=false means that range had none and the clip renders without captions. Not idempotent: each call queues another clip. Returns expected_clip_index; poll katto_get_clips every 15-30 s until a clip with that clip_index appears.

aspect.description: Output aspect ratio. Omit to keep the job's setting (9:16 by default).

auto_reframe.description: false = plain center crop instead of following the speaker. Omit for automatic reframing.

end_seconds.description: End of the clip, in seconds of the source video. The clip must last 3 to 180 seconds.

id.description: Job id of a completed job (from katto_create_clip_job).

start_seconds.description: Start of the clip, in seconds of the SOURCE video (read timestamps from katto_get_transcript).

name: katto_create_clip
